title: Critical multi-service request disruption
alert_or_symptom: Public API requests, user sign-ins and order submissions are failing across the United Kingdom and Ireland storefronts.

technical_evidence.observation: Public API request success fell from 99.8 percent to 0.6 percent at 09:42 across the United Kingdom and Ireland storefronts.
Token issuance success fell to 0.4 percent and order-creation success fell to 0.7 percent at the same time.
The Application Compute Cluster reports a network partition between workload nodes and the cluster service endpoint; affected workloads cannot establish internal connections.
Requests to the Public API Gateway, Identity and Access Service and Order Management Service stop at the compute-connection stage before application handlers are reached.
The DNS, CDN and Load-Balancing Platform, Transaction Database Cluster and Message Broker are healthy and operating normally.

service_impact.user_impact_description: Customers cannot sign in, retrieve account data or submit orders through the affected channels.
service_impact.business_function_affected: Customer access, authentication and order processing

environmental_context: The Public API Gateway, Identity and Access Service and Order Management Service run on the Application Compute Cluster.
The edge, transaction-data and messaging platforms remain healthy.
additional_context: The impact began simultaneously across all three reported services at 09:42.
No data loss, duplicate orders or security exposure has been observed.
